create_dataset_from_name: create a dataset instance by calling dataset_from_name with a name like FB_ssnpp1M or Contriever1M
get_queries_from_dataset: get query vectors from a DatasetFB_ssnpp or DatasetContrieverEmb instance using the get_queries method
get_train_vectors: get training vectors from a dataset instance using get_train with an optional maxtrain parameter
get_database_vectors: get database vectors from a dataset instance using the get_database method
get_groundtruth_labels: get ground truth labels from a dataset instance using get_groundtruth with an optional k parameter
